build_concatenation_attention: build a ConcatenationAttention module to compute attention weights by concatenating image and text features
build_project_attention: build a ProjectAttention module to compute attention weights by projecting image and text features separately
build_topdown_attention: build a TopDownAttention module to compute attention with softmax or sigmoid normalization and optional masking
build_self_attention: build a SelfAttention module with multi-head attention and feed-forward network for transformer-style self-attention
build_self_guided_attention: build a SelfGuidedAttention module with self and cross attention for guided multimodal feature alignment
